parameters.name: HoneypotImageName
parameters.description: The name of the image that is used for the honeypot.

parameters.name: HoneypotPresetId
parameters.description:
The ID of the honeypot template.

> You can call the [ListHoneypotPreset](~~ListHoneypotPreset~~) operation to query the IDs of honeypot templates.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

parameters.name: Meta
parameters.description:
The custom configurations of the honeypot template. The value is a JSON string that contains the following fields:

*   **portrait_option**: Social Source Tracing
*   **burp**: Burp-specific Defense
*   **trojan_git**: Git-specific Defense

parameters.name: PresetName
parameters.description: The custom name of the honeypot template.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-honeypot-preset --honeypot-image-name metabase --preset-name apc_web_python --honeypot-preset-id f75eddce-e9d3-4a88-af95-b10b6f65xxxx --meta portrait_option_:true,_burp_:_open --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpdateHoneypotPreset --region cn-hangzhou --HoneypotImageName metabase --Meta 'portrait_option_:true,_burp_:_open' --Lang zh --PresetName apc_web_python --HoneypotPresetId 'f75eddce-e9d3-4a88-af95-b10b6f65xxxx'
